text.description_html:
DoralLock Single Cylinder Contractor/Construction Keyed Deadbolt

These Construction Keyed Deadbolts (Contractor Keyed) are supplied with 2 different key sets. The "Contractor Key" is used during the under construction phase. The "Customer Key" is used when the all construction is completed. When the "Customer Key" is used the first time, the "Contractor Key" will no longer open the lock.

This security feature allows construction workers to have a key to access the building when necessary, but remove the security concerns that they will duplicate the key for future unauthorized access.

These High Grade Single Cylinder Deadbolts (keyed lock on the outside and a turnbolt on the inside) are made with high quality brass lock cylinders and trim.

Features of DoralLock DOR-7301KA2P Contractor Key Single Cylinder Deadbolt

  • Adjustable backset for both standard 2-3/8" and 2-3/4"
  • Fit standard pre-drilled doors
  • Full 1" Bolt throw
  • 1" Deadbolt with Hardened Steel Core
  • ANSI Grade 2 Security
  • Easy to install
  • Brass Kwikset Compatible keyway
